audit.why: EVEN at 6/10 fits 52.39% over 481 games — Poppy's levels 1-3, a long even stretch, then Gangplank's from first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Gangplank level 1 and Poppy both item stages, inverting the entry's own prose: whys[0] says her chip 'win[s] every short trade' at 1, whys[5] says the Sheen spike is where you out-burst her, whys[6] says you zone and burst her from range at 2 items.
audit.why: Poppy out-trades a keg-less Gangplank and free-hits barrels before they gain HP; once Sheen lands and Remove Scurvy cures the E wall-stun, an immobile melee tank has nothing.
audit.corrected: One group: L1 Poppy 3/10, L2 Skill 5/10, L3 Skill 5/10, L4-5 Skill 5/10, L6 Skill 5/10, First item Gangplank 7/10, 2+ items Gangplank 8/10.
sources: currentText.whys[0], whys[2], whys[3], whys[4], whys[5], whys[6]

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Charge is described only as a 'wall-pin stun' with no cooldown, no range, and no statement of the condition. Steadfast Presence's scaling resistances are absent, as is the buckler shield.
audit.why: Riot text: E 'dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned' — 14/13/12/11/10, 475 range. Standing away from terrain removes the stun entirely, which is actionable in a way 'don't get pinned' is not. W: 'passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health' — so she gets harder to finish exactly when your poke has her low. Passive: she gains a shield if she collects the thrown buckler.
audit.corrected: E given 14s / 475 and the no-wall-no-stun rule; W's low-Health resist scaling added to the don'ts; the buckler pickup added to what she wants.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Poppy 'he' and 'him' throughout the trade lines and don'ts.
audit.why: Poppy is female and the content layer uses 'she' — the two layers read as different champions.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in the trade lines, do's, don'ts and trading report.
